note: Supply-chain pins for TripoSR. The model revision and artifact hashes and sizes were recorded by scripts/pin_triposr_weights.py on 2026-10-11. The config.yaml SHA-256 was calculated from downloaded bytes because Hub metadata did not report it. Do not edit pins by hand; any change requires a reviewed pinning run and committed diff. A complete lock verifies artifact identity but does not prove inference correctness. The auxiliary DINO config licence note remains unverified.

aux_files.purpose: TripoSR's DINOSingleImageTokenizer downloads this ViT architecture config from the Hub every time the model is constructed (tsr/models/tokenizers/image.py). The loader substitutes this pinned, checksum-verified copy so no unpinned download happens at runtime.
aux_files.licence_note: Apache-2.0 per the model card as remembered by the author; NOT verified (Hub unreachable from the build sandbox). Architecture hyper-parameters only, no weights.
